blocks.text: CEBU CITY — More criminal complaints could be filed against Thomas Wayne Markle Sr. as authorities continue examining volumes of materials surrendered to police, including photographic film negatives that could yield additional evidence of alleged child sexual abuse and exploitation materials. The development comes as a federal grand jury in the United States indicted the 82-year-old Florida resident on two counts of possession of child pornography involving 35 mm film negatives, according to an announcement by the US attorney’s office in the Central District of California on Tuesday, Nov. 24 (US Time).
